response: Yes, combination tests of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) and free prostate-specific antigen (fPSA) can improve the detection of prostate cancer. The ratio of free to total PSA (%fPSA) has been shown to increase the specificity of PSA testing, helping to differentiate between prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). This can reduce unnecessary biopsies and improve the early detection of prostate cancer.
